verdict_scope: Scientific design is coherent; implementation fidelity and operational gates remain mandatory before biomedical execution.

execution_gates.title: Quota runtime enforcement
execution_gates.resolution: 96 rounds cycle eight cells twelve times with 30 rows each; four final rounds add 15 to each of two cells; all 100 metadata entries verified.
execution_gates.action: Bind cell indexes to the original sex-age cells and test runtime enforcement, transitions, wrong-cell/count/range rejection, bounded repairs and no post-hoc replacement.

execution_gates.title: Macro target commitments
execution_gates.resolution: All empirical, derived and assumed numerical targets are immutable; new inference uses a separate source-only context with admitted schema/targets, excluding generated frequencies and evaluation results; unresolved groups are excluded after the fixed allowance.
execution_gates.action: Verify context isolation, target hash/version binding, repeated-group reuse, normalization/margin/quota compatibility checks, counted repair and recorded exclusion.

execution_gates.title: Paper fidelity and common backbone
execution_gates.action: Complete v4 prompt parity, schema and sampler decisions; independently review the 100-round scripted trace and bounded live parsing fixtures; freeze one implementation before biomedical performance.

execution_gates.title: Actual model-resource metering
execution_gates.action: Pin model/service/version and inference settings, meter logical operations and actual visible usage, count repairs/missing-joint inference/scientific review within 234 requests, enforce per-response and total ceilings, and fix a finite active-time limit before release.

execution_gates.title: Native cumulative trajectory and row ledger
execution_gates.action: Bind append-only batches and cumulative hashes; freeze malformed-round/repair rules; count partial, invalid and discarded draws; specify EVC versus LLMSynthor sampled-row ceilings; prohibit hidden trajectory restarts or final resampling.

execution_gates.title: Clean inputs and new episode evaluator
execution_gates.action: Rebuild identical curated packets without old author artifacts, verify actual read boundaries, derive a separate 20-episode controller/evaluator, and preserve estimator definitions, reference bindings and missing mappings.

execution_gates.title: Result and uncertainty interpretation
execution_gates.action: Retain all scheduled slots and endpoint values, preserve reference-band limitations and unavailable values, label five-episode spread as mixed computational variability, report interventions/cost scope, and retain developmental exposure.
